# 74H11 - Triple 3-input AND gate

Package DIP-14 · family 74H · catalogue file [catalog/chips/74H11.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/74H11.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 7 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![74H11 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/74H11.png) | ![74H11 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/and3.png) | ![74H11 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/and3.png) |

The split AND rectangle (triangle in the right half) with three inputs.

How to tell it on a drawing: As 7408 with three inputs.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 6 | 2Y = 2A AND 2B AND 2C | 2Y is the AND of 2A, 2B, 2C. |
| 8 | 3Y = 3A AND 3B AND 3C | 3Y is the AND of 3A, 3B, 3C. |
| 12 | 1Y = 1A AND 1B AND 1C | 1Y is the AND of 1A, 1B, 1C. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| inputSchmitt | no |

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 2 kohm, CL 15 pF.

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| any | Y | PLH | 8 | 15 |
| any | Y | PHL | 10 | 20 |

## Not known

- No 74H11 (high-speed TTL) datasheet was found. Pins and function come from the SN74LS11 sheet (same pinout); outputLowMaxCurrentMa, outputHighMaxCurrentMa and the real 74H propagation delays are unknown.

## Notes

The datasheet gives no minimum propagation delay; minNs is null (the path-delay function uses 0 ns). No setup/hold/pulse-width limits apply to a gate, so timingLimits is empty. The timing entries are SN74LS figures (LS family) and must not be read as 74H values.

## Sources

- [TI SN54LS11/SN74LS11/SN54S11/SN74S11 datasheet SDLS131](https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/sn74ls11.pdf) - 1, 3; SN74LS11

## Used on sheets

No sheet in this repository uses this chip yet.
